title: 3X or 3% Returns?
description:
AI strategy should not stop at one isolated use case.

The real question is: 3x or 3%? What will your AI strategy yield?

If you only optimize one task, you can still leave bottlenecks on both sides of that work. But when you optimize a full business domain, the AI gains that you get from a single use case are amplified by every single step of the process.

Focus on domains that are both profitable and feasible. That is where AI stops being a random tool and starts becoming a real business strategy.
#aistrategy #businessai #aiforbusiness #ai
